title: Tile and Stone Setters
description: Apply hard tile, stone, and comparable materials to walls, floors, ceilings, countertops, and roof decks.

tasks.text: Align and straighten tile using levels, squares, and straightedges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning masonry is skilled manual work

tasks.text: Finish and dress the joints and wipe excess grout from between tiles, using damp sponge.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal of excess construction materials

dwas.name: Remove excess materials from finished construction projects.

tasks.text: Cut and shape tile to fit around obstacles and into odd spaces and corners, using hand and power cutting tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Masonry cutting requires skilled manual work

dwas.name: Cut tile, stone, or other masonry materials.

tasks.text: Determine and implement the best layout to achieve a desired pattern.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Layouts need site survey and engineering sign-off

tasks.text: Mix, apply, and spread plaster, concrete, mortar, cement, mastic, glue or other adhesives to form a bed for the tiles, using brush, trowel and screed.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of substances in workspace

dwas.name: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.
Spread concrete or other aggregate mixtures.

tasks.text: Study blueprints and examine surface to be covered to determine amount of material needed.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Specs reading aided, human validates requirements

dwas.name: Review blueprints or specifications to determine work requirements.

tasks.text: Measure and mark surfaces to be tiled, following blueprints.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical site dimension measurement

dwas.name: Measure work site dimensions.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

dwas.name: Mark reference points on construction materials.

tasks.text: Lay and set mosaic tiles to create decorative wall, mural, and floor designs.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Aligning masonry is skilled manual work

tasks.text: Apply mortar to tile back, position the tile, and press or tap with trowel handle to affix tile to base.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on adhesive application in unstructured construction settings

tasks.text: Mix and apply mortar or cement to edges and ends of drain tiles to seal halves and joints.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of substances in workspace

dwas.name: Mix substances or compounds needed for work activities.

tasks.text: Apply a sealer to make grout stain- and water-resistant.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Applying sealants requires hands-on coating

dwas.name: Apply sealants or other protective coatings.

tasks.text: Level concrete and allow to dry.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual spreading of concrete and aggregates

dwas.name: Spread concrete or other aggregate mixtures.

tasks.text: Measure and cut metal lath to size for walls and ceilings, using tin snips.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical measurement for assembly fitting

dwas.name: Measure materials or objects for installation or assembly.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Install and anchor fixtures in designated positions, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Installing fixtures requires manual dexterity

tasks.text: Prepare surfaces for tiling by attaching lath or waterproof paper, or by applying a cement mortar coat to a metal screen.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on adhesive application in unstructured construction settings

tasks.text: Remove and replace cracked or damaged tile.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal of worn materials

dwas.name: Remove worn, damaged or outdated materials from work areas.

tasks.text: Cut tile backing to required size, using shears.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hand cutting of flexible flooring materials

dwas.name: Cut carpet, vinyl or other flexible materials.

tasks.text: Remove any old tile, grout and adhesive using chisels and scrapers and clean the surface carefully.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Surface preparation is hands-on physical work

dwas.name: Clean surfaces in preparation for work activities.
Remove worn, damaged or outdated materials from work areas.

tasks.text: Cut, surface, polish, and install marble and granite or install pre-cast terrazzo, granite or marble units.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Abrasive hand work on physical surfaces

dwas.name: Cut tile, stone, or other masonry materials.
Smooth surfaces with abrasive materials or tools.

tasks.text: Spread mastic or other adhesive base on roof deck to form base for promenade tile, using serrated spreader.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on adhesive application in unstructured construction settings

tasks.text: Assist customers in selection of tile and grout.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Client dialogue on products/policies is relational

dwas.name: Communicate with clients about products, procedures, and policies.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Prepare cost and labor estimates, based on calculations of time and materials needed for project.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Construction cost estimation needs site judgment

dwas.name: Estimate construction project costs.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Brush glue onto manila paper on which design has been drawn and position tiles, finished side down, onto paper.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on adhesive application in unstructured construction settings

tasks.text: Select and order tile and other items to be installed, such as bathroom accessories, walls, panels, and cabinets, according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Construction material selection needs code and site judgment

dwas.name: Order construction or extraction materials or equipment.

tasks.text: Build underbeds and install anchor bolts, wires, and brackets.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Masonry requires skilled manual labor
